answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it may trade, like yarrow roots anchoring a plant: one identity, one bond, and misbehaviour burns the deposit. An ivory-tower registry is not enough — the stake must sit on-chain where anyone can verify it. Attackers face karst-like terrain: every fake identity costs real capital, so creating thousands of sock-puppets becomes prohibitively expensive while honest agents recover their bond.
